clue.text: They go on foot to give Navy record return in trading ships

indicators.note: in tells us the navy and record pieces are placed inside the word for trading ships

parts.note: coasters are merchant vessels that ply along a coast
RN is the Royal Navy

indicators.note: return tells us the record's abbreviation is turned to run backwards

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A sea-themed instruction about giving the Navy something back from merchant vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns LP into PL; RN and PL then go inside COASTERS after CO. Corn plasters are medicated pads stuck on corns.
explanation.definitionFit: Corn plasters are small adhesive pads applied to the toes and soles to ease corns.

clue.text: Last man in Chu Chin Chow

definitions.meaning: a shoemaker, who shapes shoes on a foot-shaped form called a last
a character in the Ali Baba musical, Baba Mustafa, who mends shoes

explanation.walkthrough: Chu Chin Chow was a long-running London musical based on Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.
explanation.definitionFit: A shoemaker works over a last, and the Ali Baba story has a shoe-mender who stitches up a body.

definitions.meaning: the underground parts of a plant attach to its trunk; Tree may also hint at the actor-manager Herbert Beerbohm Tree

explanation.definitionFit: Wesker's drama bears this title, and every trunk grows from such underground parts.

definitions.meaning: a flowering plant, the scarlet variety a small red wildflower
Chauvelin, the French agent in Baroness Orczy's novel, is constantly foiled by the hero known as the Scarlet one

explanation.walkthrough: The page prints Chaurelin for Chauvelin. The pun is on scarlet, meaning red-faced with embarrassment.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet variety is a red wildflower and also the disguised English hero who torments Chauvelin.

indicators.note: the jobs have lost their start, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: tasks are jobs

explanation.surface: Requests for work are piling up because the jobs never got going.
explanation.definitionFit: To ask for something is to request it, so requests here are demands.

clue.text: Menace of rate reform came in at that time

indicators.note: came in says the reworked letters enter the word for at that time

parts.note: then means at that time

indicators.note: reform asks for the word rate to be formed again in a new order

explanation.surface: A threat arose from a change in tax rate introduced back then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' rearranges RATE into REAT, which goes into THEN after TH.
explanation.definitionFit: To menace someone is to intimidate them with possible harm.

definitions.meaning: the hooded bandit of Sherwood Forest
a thing that flies, here a small red-breasted garden bird

explanation.definitionFit: Robin Hood is the legendary outlaw, and the red-breasted garden songbird flies.

clue.text: Perhaps Don Brook could be used for the opening turn

definitions.text: could be used for the opening turn

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the name is only one possible arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A man called Don Brook might be put on to open proceedings.
explanation.definitionFit: One grips and twists a handle like this to open a door.

clue.text: Epithet isn't meant to include a nereid

indicators.note: the words are said to include the answer within their letters

explanation.surface: A scholar remarks that a certain epithet was meant to cover a sea nymph.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'Epithet isn't'; 'meant' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Thetis, mother of Achilles, was one of the fifty sea nymphs, daughters of Nereus.

definitions.meaning: one who deals in bets, taking wagers on races
someone who writes volumes, a novelist being one example

explanation.definitionFit: A bookie runs a betting book, and a writer literally produces books.

clue.text: Nothing between the two ? Vote here

indicators.note: between says the nothing piece sits inside the word for the two

parts.note: both means the two together
O is the round figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone torn between two choices is told where to go and cast a ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: A polling booth is the small enclosure where a voter marks the ballot paper.

clue.text: Surgeon with a pound tries to get change

parts.note: L stands for a pound, from the Latin libra

indicators.note: the word tries is told to change, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor armed with a pound coin attempts to get some loose change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get change' rearranges TRIES into ISTER after L. Joseph Lister was the Victorian surgeon who pioneered antiseptic surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph Lister was the famous British surgeon who introduced antiseptic methods in operating theatres.

clue.text: Old knight sees girl in Monty's cap

indicators.note: in places the girl's name within the headgear

parts.note: Field Marshal Montgomery was famous for his black beret
Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An elderly knight spots a young woman wearing a famous general's hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sees' is a link. Monty is Field Marshal Montgomery, the British Second World War commander known for his beret; ANN goes in after B.
explanation.definitionFit: A banneret was a medieval knight entitled to lead men under his own banner.

clue.text: Resentment returns about one Canadian city

indicators.note: about says the turned word goes round the piece for one
returns signals that the word for resentment is read backwards

parts.note: anger is a synonym for resentment
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Bitterness keeps coming back concerning a particular Canadian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns ANGER into REGNA, which then goes about I.
explanation.definitionFit: Regina is the capital of the prairie province of Saskatchewan.

parts.note: to give is to hand over
sway means power or control, as in holding sway

explanation.definitionFit: To give way is to concede or collapse under pressure.

clue.text: Comments upon ADCs sent For replacement

indicators.note: the letters are sent off to be replaced, i.e. reordered into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on aides-de-camp who have been sent off to be replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: ADCs are aides-de-camp, officers assisting a general; here they are just letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To descant on a subject is to talk at length about it, remarking freely.

clue.text: Dish, supplied by sweet store for a groom ?

parts.note: a curry is a spicy dish
a honeycomb stores honey, a sweet substance

explanation.surface: A meal and some honeycomb are laid on for a bridegroom.
explanation.walkthrough: The groom is a stable hand, not a bridegroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A currycomb is the ridged tool a stable hand uses to clean a horse's coat.

indicators.note: deciphered suggests the letters of the name and word are unscrambled into new order

explanation.surface: A coded note is decoded by Meg afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A telegram was a written communication sent by wire and delivered by hand.

parts.note: not a used gun but one whose turning, like the second hand on a clock face, suggests a gun with a rotating cylinder

explanation.definitionFit: A revolver is a pistol whose cylinder rotates, just as a second hand goes round a dial.

parts.note: not a horse but the king's nephew, the Royalist cavalry leader famed for headlong charges in the Civil War

explanation.definitionFit: Prince Rupert of the Rhine commanded Charles I's cavalry and was noted for his dashing charges.

indicators.note: about says the song goes round the sailor piece

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera
AB is an able-bodied seaman, a sailor

explanation.surface: A folk tune about a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: AB goes inside ARIA after AR, giving AR-AB-IA.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabia is the peninsula and historic region of south-west Asia, here taken as a land.

parts.note: mere means a lake, not merely: a crater lake near Naples was held to be the way into the underworld

explanation.definitionFit: Lake Avernus near Cumae was believed by the Romans to be the gateway to the underworld.

definitions.meaning: short excerpts taken from written works

explanation.definitionFit: A passage is both a quoted section of text and a trip across water.

indicators.note: the boss word loses its head, its first letter

parts.note: a master is a boss

explanation.surface: A boss makes a mistake after losing his head.
explanation.walkthrough: Bloomer is a flower here, not a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: The Michaelmas daisy and its relatives are flowering garden plants.

clue.text: Shrub is backward-try to put in tree.

indicators.note: backward tells us the whole assembled piece is read in reverse
put in says the word try is placed inside the tree

parts.note: an elm is a common tree

explanation.surface: A gardener is told to plant a bush in a tree, the advice being backward.
explanation.walkthrough: TRY inside ELM gives ELTRYM, and 'backward' reverses the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Myrtle is an evergreen bush with fragrant white flowers, sacred to Venus.

parts.note: the boards are the stage, and Shakespeare put a misanthrope of Athens on it

explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's play about the misanthropic Athenian puts him on stage.

indicators.note: holding says the practice word holds the letter a
in a down clue up means the built piece reads from bottom to top

parts.note: use means practice, custom

explanation.surface: Customs supporting a figure from Scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts A inside USE, giving UASE; 'up' (within 'upholding') reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Esau was Jacob's elder brother in Genesis, who sold his birthright for pottage.

definitions.meaning: to cook meat in an oven
a cut of meat cooked in the oven, the Sunday dinner

explanation.definitionFit: To roast is to bake meat dry in an oven, and the Sunday joint so cooked bears the same name.

clue.text: County has right to very big piece of land

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, very big
a common is an open area of public land

explanation.surface: A county claims rights to a vast tract of ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Roscommon is a county in the west of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Roscommon is one of the counties of the Irish province of Connacht.

parts.note: not a child's pictures but the prize draws made by the computer nicknamed ERNIE, Electronic Random Number Indicator Equipment

explanation.walkthrough: ERNIE is the machine that picks the winning numbers in the British government's savings lottery.
explanation.definitionFit: These British savings certificates pay out no interest but enter monthly prize draws run by the computer ERNIE.
